entries.conditions: accepted and silently miscomputed: a RANK-0 tensor entering broadcast arithmetic. Measured with a CPU-vs-GPU tensor diff on identical inputs — a bare `arange` matches CPU exactly and `100.0 + arange` matches exactly, but `rank0_scalar + arange` does not (CPU [12,13,14,15], GPU max 12). Any selector built from that index comes back all-zero, so the mamba pad guard stored an all-zero conv state in every layer and generation collapsed. No rejection is logged — the graph reports full delegation

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: measured: index, selector and gather all match CPU exactly afterwards; granite-4.0-h-1b then answers correctly on device (8Q 8/8 on Mac GPU)
rewrite_hints.rewrite: keep the batch dimension when reducing: `sum(-1, keepdim=True)` -> (B,1), then broadcast at rank >= 1
rewrite_hints.symptom: full delegation, coherent-looking graph, but every stored conv state is exactly 0.0 and the model emits token 0 forever

Same two models, same failure on Mac Metal 2.1.6 and the CLiteRTLM-mac runtime — a cross-backend ml_drift kernel limit on odd int8 head shapes (161-label classification head; 128802-row tied-vocab head)

entries.conditions: runtime log line, verbatim: 'STABLEHLO_COMPOSITE: odml.softmax'. The composite is left un-lowered by the export and the delegate refuses it, collapsing the whole decoder to CPU: 52/1187 nodes delegated (Shieldstral-1.0-3B-vision int4) and 57/1626 (MedGemma-1.5-4B-IT q4). For Shieldstral the text-only export of the same weights delegates 1187/1187 -- an in-family control that isolates the vision-bundled export path. MedGemma is NOT the same story: its text file fails identically to its vision file (57/1626 both), so 'text-only' is not a general escape from this composite
